title: qang: the Qang (qg) unit and metric for parametric quantum circuit design

creators.name: Monteverde, Vicente Humberto
creators.affiliation: Universidad del Museo Social Argentino (UMSA), Argentina

description: Python library for the qang (qg) framework: qubits described by measurement-level quantities (the polar bias qg_Z = <sigma_z> and its companions), native qg-parameterized gates for Qiskit, Cirq, PennyLane and TensorCircuit, few-shot qg estimators, the qg symmetry witness and filter, weight-conserving QNN classifiers read with and without the filter, the qg formulation of 15 gates and 14 algorithms with the local Bloch radius, and polarization optics and geometric phase in qg units. The core is NumPy-only (79 modules; JAX, Qiskit, Cirq and PennyLane are optional extras). The qga angular scale (1000 qga = 1 turn), the Fisher and Berry phase in qga, and the no-go result that no function of a single Z-basis distribution certifies entanglement. Adapters for IBM Quantum (Runtime) and IQM (Garnet) hardware, and 15 SDK integrations (Braket, CUDA-Q, JAX, Mitiq, pytket, Qibo, Qiskit Dynamics, Qiskit Experiments, QuTiP, scikit-learn, Stim, PyTorch and others). Ships the bilingual book 'Quantum Computing, Information and Physics in qang Space' (English and Spanish), whose chapters 7-44 carry a ledger of 204 sub-measures with an explicit status each. 205 test modules with 1,099 test functions.
